title.tr: Geniş cam kapılı beyaz ev ve taş zeminli teras
title.en: White house with wide glass doors and a stone-floored terrace

alt.tr: Beyaz sıvalı evde koyu ahşap saçaklar ve geniş cam kapılar; önünde taş zeminli teras
alt.en: White plastered house with dark timber eaves and wide glass doors, a stone-floored terrace in front

caption.tr: Ev kademeli çatılı, teras girişinde iki ahşap kolon var. Terasın önünde kereste ve toprak bırakılmış.
caption.en: The house has a stepped roof and two timber posts at the terrace entrance. Timber and soil are left in front of the terrace.
